analysis:
Examined all supplied ProviderLoop.swift excerpts and both files' change maps/patch evidence. ProviderLoop.swift:724-735 adds actor-owned selected-model recovery state, a nil-by-default internal load override, and saved/start-versus-switch selection bookkeeping; line 897 initializes the saved selection from configuration. These declarations alone do not change admission, encryption, authorization, hash verification, cache isolation, or billing. Surrounding code retains process-generated X25519 keys, runtime-eligibility filtering, bounded slot/KV configuration, and separate load-bound artifact/cache identities. No supported regression was identified against T-010, T-012/T-027, T-029, T-041, T-053 or T-059.
DaemonState+Coding.swift metadata and bounded patch add optional selection and recovery fields to coding keys and decoding (head:13-15,37-41). Model-selection metadata is not prompt content or serving permission; optional decoding preserves compatibility with absent fields. Full source and the encoding patch tail are not supplied, so this is not complete serialization coverage.
Integration must inspect ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery and its callers: ensure recovery respects drain/add-on holds, selection changes, load serialization, memory budgets, cancellation and shutdown, and cannot republish failed/unverified models or bypass current serving authorization (A-018, TB-007, TB-011, TB-012). Also reconcile state production/consumption with DaemonState+Coding.swift: selection/recovery diagnostics must remain observational and avoid new sensitive payloads. Those behaviors are outside this batch; their absence is a coverage limit, not evidence of missing controls.
